subject: Got caught segfault error when tried to import Bismark SAM file using read.bismark()

messages.author: 3eaeb7260ebb959f
messages.subject: Got caught segfault error when tried to import Bismark SAM file using read.bismark()
parts:
I got "caught segfault" error while trying to import Bismark SAM file. Following is the code I used to import SAM file. The same piece of code worked totally fine for R-3.2.2 and methylKit 0.9.5.

R code:

library("methylKit")

meth.raw <- read.bismark(location="../sorted-BAMs/AN00373.sorted.sam",
    sample.id="AN00373",
    save.context="CpG",
    read.context="CpG",
    assembly="hg38",
    save.folder="methylation-calls-files",
    treatment=c(0)
    )


OUTPUT:

 *** caught segfault ***
address 0x621, cause 'memory not mapped'

Traceback:
 1: .Call("methylKit_methCall", PACKAGE = "methylKit", read1, type,     nolap, minqual, mincov, phred64, CpGfile, CHHfile, CHGfile)
 2: methCall(read1 = location, type = "bam", nolap = nolap, minqual = minqual,     mincov = mincov, phred64 = phred64, CpGfile = out.files[["CpG"]],     CHHfile = out.files[["CHH"]], CHGfile = out.files[["CHG"]])
 3: .local(location, sample.id, assembly, save.folder, save.context,     read.context, nolap, mincov, minqual, phred64, save.db)
 4: processBismarkAln(location, sample.id, assembly, save.folder,     save.context, read.context, nolap, mincov, minqual, phred64,     treatment, save.db)
 5: processBismarkAln(location, sample.id, assembly, save.folder,     save.context, read.context, nolap, mincov, minqual, phred64,     treatment, save.db)
 6: read.bismark(location = "../sorted-BAMs/AN00373.sorted.sam",     sample.id = "AN00373", save.context = "CpG", read.context = "CpG",     assembly = "hg38", save.folder = "methylation-calls-files-new",     treatment = c(0))
